today.pillar: The logbook: travel and founder origin
today.body: This is the first day of the calendar. Film the origin story: a designer who built the business across 15 countries, found the world had no soul left to fire his fire, and came home to Brasília to build folders. Include the Turkey hostel beat so Tuesday's reel can be cut from this take. If logbook/archive is not live yet, the video still ships on YouTube and the post follows.
today.hook: I built a business across 15 countries. Then I came home, because the world ran out of fire. This is what I'm building now.
talking_points: I built a business across 15 countries. A hostel in Turkey, a laptop, a client site going live. That was the office.
I didn't come back to Brazil to slow down. I came back because this is where my fire still burns.
untitledfolderr.co is not an agency anymore. It's a folder of folders, and each one unfolds into an app.
A profile is rented land. A site, a list and a database are ground you own. Use the first to build the second.
Post less. Mean more. Send every view somewhere you own.

blocks.heading: Value equation
blocks.equation: Value = (Dream outcome × Perceived likelihood) / (Time delay × Effort and sacrifice)
blocks.text: Push the top up, the bottom down.

blocks.heading: Grand slam offer
blocks.text: Make the offer hard to refuse: a named core, stacked bonuses, a guarantee, and real scarcity. Owned-Ground Launch is the example on the table: the site, Portal, hosting, and a full export anytime.

blocks.heading: Sovereignty: rented vs owned ground
blocks.text: Own your ground. If you can't export it, you don't own it.

reels_rules.intro: Keep the raw single take, with the whiteboard appearing while you speak. Make it tighter with a fast hook, clean overlays, and one close.

steps.title: 0–2 s: the payoff
steps.detail: Open on the conclusion or flash the end diagram.

steps.title: 2–10 s: why it matters
steps.detail: One line of context or a story beat.

steps.title: Body: the framework
steps.detail: 3 steps max, one idea each, single take.

steps.title: CTA: one line
steps.detail: Comment a keyword or link in bio. Never two CTAs.

rows.title: Raw single take + end diagram
rows.detail: Filmed wherever you are. One simple framework per reel.

rows.title: Slow openers
rows.detail: Do not start with a warm-up. Lead with the payoff.

rows.title: Missing captions
rows.detail: Always burn captions in. Proofread before publishing.

rows.title: No CTA
rows.detail: End every reel with one CTA.
